messages:
Nina: Noticed a region S3 blip this morning that caused mass fallback warmups; IO spiked and prefix-kv evicted heavily.

Omar: Do we have a quick mitigation idea?

Nina: Proposal: header-first probe (read ~4KB), then choose transport. Add hysteresis on transport health (require sustained failures over 30s).

Wei: Also add a warmup_memory_token pool; each bulk warmup must acquire tokens proportional to shard size, prevents OOM thrash.

Omar: And sequential_fallback by default. Only critical shards can parallel fallback.

Ops-bot: Created checklist: feature flag transport_probe_v2, metric warmup.memory_tokens, alert warmup.pressure.

Nina: Tests: unit for probe stats, sim outage chaos test. Action items: Wei implements token pool, Omar drafts probe API, Nina wires canary flags.
